interpretation_hint: A running instance of a SHACLFlow bound to a specific base expression. Persists the flow's identity as a URI (which SHACLFlow shape this instantiates — URIs collide-free across social-DNA modules, unlike bare names), the base subject it runs on, the current state name, and the RFC3339 timestamp of when the instance was started. FlowTransitionProposal nodes link back to a FlowInstance via `ad4m://flow/instance` — the URI of one of these nodes is what that predicate references.
